name: Octant Method
definition: A reconstruction strategy for cell-centered Block-Structured Adaptive Mesh Refinement (BS-AMR) data that maps a sample point p=(x,y,z) to a scalar value F(p) by decomposing the domain into non-overlapping rectilinear octants, ensuring continuity across level boundaries and supporting fast implicit ray-isosurface intersections.
summary: The Octant Method reconstructs BS-AMR data by decomposing cells into non-overlapping rectilinear octants, ensuring continuity at refinement boundaries without crossing level limits.
